<thought>To determine the number of CH₃ (methyl) groups in the compound, I will obtain its ¹H NMR spectrum. The spectrum will show signals for methyl protons, typically appearing as singlets, doublets, or multiplets around 0.8–1.2 ppm, with integration values corresponding to three protons per CH₃ group. By examining the integration of these methyl signals, I can count the total number of CH₃ groups present.</thought>
